goals.description: Implement S1: guarantee top-level criticApproved boolean, NHL puckline vs ML price-band guard, and preserve price-band text in digest odds scrubber.
goals.verificationCriteria: Final compiled payload always has typeof criticApproved === 'boolean'; NHL -1.5 (+205) vs ML (-128) guard active; stripApproximateOdds preserves price-band ranges without 'in the to range' or 'within the / window'.
goals.evidence: Implemented resolveFinalCriticApproved + wiring across criticAudit.ts, verificationPipeline.ts, synthesisPipeline.ts, index.ts, responseGuards.ts; added NHL -1.5 vs ML guidance in constants.ts and checkNhlPucklinePriceBand in marketRowBinding.ts; sentinel-protected price bands in stripApproximateOdds.

goals.description: Implement S2: cap heavy-slate proposer dossiers (<= 10 full sections + compact 1-line summaries), support espn_depthchart starter rows, and deduplicate H2H lines by (game_date, sorted_scores).
goals.verificationCriteria: 20-game slate gives a1 <= 10 full dossier sections & a2 dossierTruncated === false; espn_depthchart QB/depth_rank=1 scores Tier 1 (5.0); H2H 2026-10-28 PHI/WAS 2-5 + WSH/PHI 5-2 collapses to 1 entry.
goals.evidence: Capped heavy-slate (>=12 games) full sections <= 10 with compact 1-line summaries in unifiedDossier.ts; added scorePlayerGameLogStarterRow/scoreInjuryStarterTier for espn_depthchart and deduplicated H2H by (game_date, sorted_scores) in dueloddsRpcTools.ts.
